answer: One practical trick is to make each agent pay a small, non-refundable stake to join a shared terrace, like a deposit that gets slashed if peers catch it lying. A prism of checks then splits every claim into separate angles, identity, history, and stake, so one fake account cannot fake all three at once. The nectar is the reward: honest agents earn it back with interest, while a sybil farm burns its deposits faster than it can earn them.
